gate5_scope: The supplementary measurement (~1000 real model calls) is INITIAL QUALITY CALIBRATION ONLY. It estimates P(task correct | config, condition) under v2.1 scoring for the five frozen configs, to validate that Q_min=0.80 is a reasonable feasibility threshold and to bind per-cell quality priors. It is NOT: (1) strategy selection — the best static arm for the SS contrast is selected on independent data per Protocol V2.3 §3, never on this panel; (2) a policy-superiority claim — no hypothesis test on this panel supports H1-H4/S1; (3) an on-time probability validation — node latency distributions were measured separately and path aggregation needs its own validation. With 20 tasks per cell the binomial CI is wide (17/20 -> 64-95%): overlapping CIs are expected and uninterpretable as superiority. Q_min=0.80, eps=0.10, reward weights and every frozen formula remain UNCHANGED by construction; no result of this measurement may be used to retune them (any change would be a new frozen version with explicit rationale).
